unlisted_practices: Customizing open-source LLMs with a fixed JSON schema to extract medication attributes from heterogeneous EHR fields and free text
Cross-field consistency checks and unit checks on LLM extraction outputs to prevent mass units being misread as daily counts
Local, privacy-preserving deployment of open-source LLMs in place of site-specific ETL

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM pipelines with normalization/consistency checks for extracting medication attributes from EHR data across multiple clinic datasets, but does not test organizational deployment practices with a comparative design.
